title: Opposition to New Data Centers Grows
discussion_signal: The poll relay describes rising and cross-partisan opposition to local data-center construction, with discussion separating support for AI from willingness to absorb nearby energy, water, environmental, and community costs.
linked_research_question: Why can national support for AI coexist with local opposition to the infrastructure that makes it possible, and what would constitute genuine community consent?
limits: The post relays Annenberg polling rather than the UMass source directly
Polling attitudes are not the same as local permitting outcomes
